title: Snake
summary: Eat, grow, don't bite yourself. A full Snake with modes, a high score and an on-screen pad for phones.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD steer, Space pauses. On a phone: the pad in the corner.

source.name: JavaScript-Snake
source.changes: one flat theme with colors from config.js instead of the theme picker and its fonts and images, the speed and growth read config.js, a high score store that works in a sandboxed preview, no console logging.
